scope: Actual sysinit-launched Gaze Direction process with the physical webcam and Iride browser active. Webcam, browser and service process resources are excluded.
measurement_notes: Observed operating windows, not an equal-load comparison: no-face frames skip neural inference, and detected-face fractions differ.
CPU total percentages use all eight logical CPUs as 100%; per-core percentages use 100% for one logical CPU.
RAM is native process physical footprint. Metal driver allocations overlap unified RAM and must not be added.
GPU percentage is per-process queue time divided by observation duration, not hardware-wide shader occupancy.
Analysis latency covers face landmarks and neural analysis, excluding JPEG decode, Flow and browser latency.
Temporary timing wrappers and two allocator samples per second add a small profiling overhead included in process CPU. Profiling hooks were removed afterwards.
No electrical power, camera images or gaze coordinates were recorded.
